_about: KG evaluation metrics catalog. Each metric is a SPARQL query under kg_queries/ that produces either a scalar (single row, single binding) or a small table. Mirrors dissertation §9.3 — instance counts (§9.3.1), provenance coverage (§9.3.2), external linking coverage (§9.3.3) — plus a few derived metrics that the dissertation references in passing (triples-per-mention verbosity, activity inventory, web-manifestation depth).

metrics.title: Total triples
metrics.description: Total number of triples in the KG (after closure if loaded from viewsari_kg.inferred.ttl).

metrics.title: Instance counts by ontology class
metrics.description: Populates Table 9.11 — one row per ontology class with the materialised individual count.

metrics.title: Mention taxonomy breakdown
metrics.description: Counts per concrete mention subclass — the four leaf classes plus the artwork-specific specialisations.

metrics.title: Activity inventory
metrics.description: Number of prov:Activity instances grouped by their viewsari activity class (NER, entity linking, cooccurrence analysis).

metrics.title: Average triples per mention (verbosity proxy)
metrics.description: Triples / mentions ratio — a coarse proxy for the dissertation's claim that each mention generates 12–18 triples.

metrics.title: Provenance coverage — Listing 9.6
metrics.description: Reproduces Listing 9.6 verbatim: total annotations vs annotations with prov:wasGeneratedBy → SoftwareAgent. The withProv/total ratio should equal 1.0.

metrics.title: Provenance coverage — strict (paragraph + activity + agent)
metrics.description: Stricter variant: annotations whose provenance chain reaches a paragraph AND an activity AND a software agent simultaneously.

metrics.title: Activity → SoftwareAgent inventory
metrics.description: Each prov:Activity instance with its associated prov:SoftwareAgent (or prov:Person fallback). Confirms which model produced which run.

metrics.title: External linking coverage by entity type — Table 9.12
metrics.description: Per-class total vs Wikidata-linked count and percentage.

metrics.title: OOKB artworks
metrics.description: Number of artworks WITHOUT a wikidata.org owl:sameAs link (the OOKB long-tail discussed in §9.3.3).

metrics.title: Authority namespaces in use
metrics.description: Distinct external authorities reached through owl:sameAs (Wikidata, GeoNames, Iconclass, …).

metrics.title: Bibliographic depth — web manifestations per expression
metrics.description: How many expression-level nodes (volume, biography, page) are reachable to a Project Gutenberg web manifestation via frbr:hasEmbodiment + rdfs:seeAlso.
